fonts.instruction: Use for all headings, massive hero text, and card titles. Ensure tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Use for body text, form labels, and standard paragraphs for clean legibility.
Use for all numeric results, formulas, and metric values to instill a sense of precision.

surface_strategies.cards: Grid Borders & Sharp Edges. bg-surface, 1px solid border-border, rounded-none or max rounded-sm. No soft shadows. Hover: shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(204,255,0,1)] (Neo-brutalist pop) or subtle -translate-y-1 with neon border glow.
surface_strategies.inputs: Tactical Minimalism. bg-transparent, border-b-2 border-border, rounded-none, uppercase labels. Focus: border-primary ring-0.
surface_strategies.buttons: Sharp rects. bg-primary text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wider. Hover: bg-white (in dark mode) or bg-black text-white (in light mode) with transition-colors.
surface_strategies.header: Crystal Glass. backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 border-b border-border.

dashboard.sidebar_input_panel: w-full lg:w-96 lg:fixed h-auto lg:h-screen overflow-y-auto border-r border-border bg-surface p-6 sm:p-8 z-40
dashboard.instruction: The input panel is persistent on the left (desktop) or top (mobile). As user types, all 30 calculators in the main area update instantly. Group cards by category headers.

seo_page.hero: relative pt-32 pb-20 px-6 sm:px-12 border-b border-border overflow-hidden
seo_page.content: max-w-4xl mx-auto py-12 px-6 sm:px-12 grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-12

components.GaugeBar: A horizontal 100% width div, divided into colored segments (e.g., Underweight, Normal, Overweight). An absolute positioned triangle or vertical line indicates the user's result.
components.ResultCard: Contains: Category Icon/Chip (top left), Share icon (top right). Title. Massive Numeric Result. GaugeBar. 'View Details' link. Uses data-testid='calc-card-{id}'
components.MeasurementInput: Grouped logically (General, Dimensions). Use large touch-friendly input fields. Unit toggle switch (Metric/Imperial) at the very top.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all cards: border color changes to category color, slight lift. Button clicks: scale-95. Staggered entrance animation for the 30 cards using framer-motion.
motion.page_transitions: Smooth fade-in. No page reloads when changing calculators.

hero_background.description: Male athlete sprinting from starting blocks

icons_and_assets.usage: Use sharp, duotone or bold weights from Phosphor to match the tactical feel.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (pointer-events-none) across the whole app to kill the 'digital flatness'.
visual_enhancers.data_viz: Use simple custom SVG for body shape silhouettes or standard recharts for complex charts. Keep them monochrome with category accent colors.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard React state or Zustand for the persistent global store (sync with localStorage).
Implement the single-entry form so it recalculates all dependent formulas instantly.
Each calculator needs a route (e.g., `/calculator/bmi`). The dashboard is at `/`.
For the dashboard, lazy-load the result cards if they affect performance, but keep the calculations synchronous.
Ensure the PDF generation uses `window.print()` with a custom `@media print` CSS or a client-side library like `html2pdf.js`.
Do NOT use HTML `<input type="date">` - stick to Shadcn components where possible, but customize them aggressively to match the 'Sharp/Tactical' surface strategy.
Add data-testid attributes to all inputs and result outputs.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid AI slop: do NOT use generic centered layouts or purple-on-white gradients.
Create depth through sharp 1px borders and high contrast, not soft shadows.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Never use generic AI emojis for icons; strictly use @phosphor-icons/react.
Use 2x spacing everywhere. Cards need breathing room.
Ensure hover states explicitly set text colors, not just backgrounds.
Do not use generic font families like Inter or Roboto. Apply Clash Display for headers and Manrope for body text.
